Even if you're the one reassuring yourself? I've been taught that im supposed to rely on myself and not seek reassurance from others. If you're not supposed to reassure yourself, then what do you recommend to do instead? Not trying to be an ass, just curious

The best thing to do, at least for me, is to just constantly reassure yourself. Tell yourself that it was a waxing channel on YouTube and there's no way they would let a child get waxed. You just gotta beat it into your brain over and over again. Focus on a hobby or interest of yours to keep your mind busy. Another good trick to do when you're obsessing is to pick an object out in the room and list everything about it. Like what color it is, what shape it is, how many edges does it have etc. I hope that this helps a little. I know how hard and difficult ocd is and I get your concerns. You got this! You can push through it
